answer: A single agent must prove continuous physical cost to stay in the economy: every claim it signs burns a slice of a slowly regenerating stake that is slashed when two identities share behavior. Cloning yourself past the dune of scarcity means splitting that stake until each clone is below the earning horizon, so a sybil swarm earns less than one honest agent. Cheap rings echo each other's attestations, which the quorum detects as correlated votes and discounts to zero.
